I'm working out the symmetry rule: gaps that break left-right mirroring get filled in, while symmetric holes like the central one stay untouched. I'm sketching out a first pyramid example with a small size and color, using a triangular row structure, and deliberately placing one symmetric hole plus some asymmetric missing cells to test the rule.

Now I'm planning to build two more pyramids with different colors and widths, each with their own distinct hole patterns to demonstrate the same completion logic.
